name: real-e2e-multi-agent-closure
title: 真实本地 E2E 集成父任务与多 Agent 闭环
description: Planning-only integration parent for the governed local one-episode E2E and ordered 45-episode rollout. It coordinates accepted predecessor children; it does not authorize product code, remote push, production enablement, or external publication.
scope: planning-only; each child uses one auto_cut_bot worktree and receives a unique owner plus exact repository-relative paths/namespaces only after hash-bound TaskSnapshot admission
creator: liuzx
notes: Each implementation wave must become a separately admitted child task with its own exact TaskSnapshot, worktree and local commit. JSONL files are source lists only, never admission or pass evidence. Publication is excluded.

meta.snapshot_inputs: authority, context, base, repository, allowlist, candidate, gate-bundle, toolchain and Supervisor-contract hashes; every direct and reference-closure member has byte_length, UTF-8 EOF, full hash and selected-slice hash
